self_report.trigger_items: Similar cars,Cars hit by accident,Talk about accidents
self_report.appraisals_items_original: People can't be trusted | I have to be especially careful because you never know what can happen next | I can't rely on other people
self_report.memory_items_original: When I have memories of what happened I sometimes hear things in my head that I heard during the frightening event. | When I remember the frightening event I feel like it is happening right now. | My memories of the frightening event are like a film that plays over and over.
self_report.threat_items_original: Suddenly feeling or acting as if the stressful experience were actually happening again (as if you were actually back there reliving it)? | Having strong physical reactions when something reminded you of the stressful experience (for example, heart pounding, trouble breathing, sweating)? | Feeling jumpy or easily startled?
self_report.strategies_items_original: try hard not think about the trauma | keep mind occupied all the time | control feelings
self_report.avoidance_items_original: Seeing other people that were involved in the event or that look similar | Being in circumstances that remind me of the event (eg, being in the dark). | Going out
